description: Find specific returns across all connected channels. `query` matches a return ID or reverse-shipment tracking (AWB) number (substring). Filter by channel, return bucket, received status, and date range. Each result is a full return record (reason, qty, refund, dates). Money in minor units.

query.description: Return ID or AWB / tracking number to search for.

received.description: true = already received at warehouse; false = awaiting receipt.

since.description: ISO date — only returns initiated on/after this.

until.description: ISO date — only returns initiated on/before this.

name: search_returns
title: Search returns
